name: DoubleMemory
description: Save the selected text or link to DoubleMemory.
keywords: doublememory save capture memory bookmark read later
shell script rationale: Percent-encodes the selection and hands it to the DoubleMemory app through its doublememory:// URL scheme, using `open -g` so the app captures in the background without taking focus from what the user is reading.

options.label: Hashtag
options.description: Optional hashtag added to every saved item, for example: inbox
